title: Canonical 本地运行时幂等启动与真实健康诊断
user_outcome: 同一 canonical runtime 重复执行启动不会重复拉起服务、误杀未知进程或漂移端口，并能看到真实 API/代理/语音/worker 状态
current_facts: 共享演示端口固定为 API 4000、frontend 4175、speech 8100
attempt 2 的命令行包含判断可被 PowerShell sleep 伪造，且运行态不能证明 exact candidate commit
attempt 3 使用 nonce/PID/可执行文件/启动时间/根目录/commit/角色精确 argv/lock 的联合证明，复用只接受 exact candidate

product_alignment.p0: 真实学习证据与教师干预闭环
product_alignment.contribution: 解除 canonical runtime 不可重复启动、运行态来源不清和前后端联调不稳定阻塞
non_goals: 不修改业务 API、前端页面或数据库 schema
不自动终止任何既有或未知进程
不把健康检查冒充浏览器黄金闭环验收

minimal_tests.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用

test_evidence.name: PowerShell 语法解析
test_evidence.summary: 5 PowerShell scripts parsed and 3 Python helpers compiled.

test_evidence.name: attempt 3 隔离套件初次校准
test_evidence.summary: Exact argv validation correctly rejected the original generic positive fixture; fixture contract was restricted to temp yuzan-runtime-test directories and non-production dynamic ports.

test_evidence.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用
test_evidence.summary: Exact-commit clean startup passed; two start-core reuse calls kept identical PIDs/commit; foreign partial occupancy failed closed without kill/port change; verifier-style PowerShell sleep spoof was rejected with COMMAND_ARGV_MISMATCH; wrong commit was rejected; all launched PIDs exited in finally.

rollback: 回退本任务提交；脚本不终止、不重启既有进程，runtime-local 诊断 JSON 可直接删除
